title.en: Oh Story, Oh Story DSH or ZenStory Workbench: choose a writing workflow
title.zh: Oh Story、DSH 插件还是 ZenStory 工作台：怎么选写作环境？

answer.en: Keep the environment you already want to work in: choose Oh Story for a supported agent working on a writing-project folder; the Oh Story DSH plugin for a DSH workspace and session; or ZenStory Workbench for an account-based project workspace in the browser. Both DSH Web and ZenStory can appear in a browser—the host, files and account boundary matter more than the presence of a web page.
answer.zh: 看你想在哪里写：已经在用 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent，想让它直接在写作项目文件夹里干活，选 Oh Story；想在 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的工作区和会话里写，选 Oh Story DSH 插件；不想装任何东西、登录浏览器就能管理整个项目，选 ZenStory 工作台。DSH Web 和 ZenStory 都能在浏览器里打开，真正的差别在宿主、文件与账户：由谁来运行、文件存在哪、要不要账号。

disclosure.en: This is ZenStory AI’s first-party guide to its own three writing environments, not an independent review.
disclosure.zh: 三个都是 ZenStory AI 的第一方项目，这里是我们自己的选择建议，不是独立的第三方评测。

fit.en: Choose this when you already use a supported coding agent and want it to work with a visible writing-project directory. You do not need to move an established project into another product just to follow this guide.
fit.zh: 已经在用受支持的编程 Agent，希望它直接读写你的写作项目文件夹时选它。已有项目不用为此搬到别的产品里。

environment.en: Install the skill pack using the adapter documented for your host, then run its setup/check workflow in the intended project. Integrations are not identical: some hosts use skills-only or solo/direct execution rather than every custom agent and hook.
environment.zh: 按你用的 Agent 安装对应的 skill 包，在写作项目里运行 setup/check。各 Agent 的支持程度不同：有的只能装 skill，或只能单线程直接执行，没有完整的自定义 Agent 和 hooks。

configuration.en: The pack supplies skills and reference material; it is not a model bundle. Review the selected host’s model, tool, permission and data-processing configuration. A local skills directory alone does not establish offline inference or private processing.
configuration.zh: skill 包只提供 skill 和参考资料，不带模型。模型、工具、权限和数据怎么处理，要在你用的 Agent 里自己检查。skills 装在本地，不代表推理在本地进行、处理过程保密。

files.en: Work is organized as project files. The import workflow explicitly distinguishes an analysis-only library from a resumable writing project with setting, outline, draft and tracking material. Choose that intent before importing an authorized manuscript.
files.zh: 结果都存成项目文件。导入已有稿件前先想好：只做拆文分析，还是建一个带设定、大纲、正文和追踪记录、可以接着写的工程。导入的稿件需要有授权。

version.en: The direct-pack source reviewed here is commit `070d744`. Check the version and adapter actually installed in your writing project. Do not assume that it matches the separately bundled DSH snapshot, even when skill names look similar.
version.zh: 本页核对的独立 skill 包源码是 commit `070d744`。请看你项目里实际装的版本和适配方式；名字相同的 skill，也不一定和 DSH 另外打包的版本一样。

review.en: Read the setting and chapter changes, including unresolved fields and tracking state. A reference gate, hook or deterministic check is a workflow aid—not proof of literary quality, perfect continuity or publication acceptance.
review.zh: 检查设定和章节的改动，以及还没填的字段和追踪记录。参考资料检查、hooks 和自动检查只是辅助，不能保证文笔、前后完全一致或投稿一定通过。

zh: [导入方式与生成的项目文件](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/skills/story-import/SKILL.md#L63-L72)
[参考资料检查与不支持时的处理](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/070d744b075024b530d1befbaa2474531f4700a1/skills/story-long-write/SKILL.md#L20-L41)

fit.en: Choose the plugin when DSH is the host you want to keep for your workspace, tools and sessions. Its workbenches live inside DSH Web; no ZenStory Workbench account is involved.
fit.zh: 想继续在 DSH 里管理工作区、工具和会话时选它。它的工作台就在 DSH Web 里，不需要 ZenStory 工作台账号。

environment.en: Use a DSH Web profile and the versioned installation guide, which lists Node.js 24+. DSH owns the workspace, permissions, session and UI; the creation plugin does not launch a second agent runtime.
environment.zh: 用 DSH Web 版，按带版本号的安装说明安装（需要 Node.js 24+）。工作区、权限、会话和界面都由 DSH 管；插件不会另起一个 Agent。

configuration.en: Configure a model/provider in DSH for AI creation. Other bundled production workflows can require additional media services or local tools. Being able to view existing work does not establish that generation credentials and dependencies are ready.
configuration.zh: 开始写之前，先在 DSH 里配好模型和服务商。包里的其他制作流程可能还要媒体服务或本地工具。能打开已有作品，不代表生成所需的密钥和依赖都已配好。

files.en: Select a workspace and session. Creation views appear when recognized project files exist; an empty workspace can remain in native DSH Chat. Treat manuscript files and host/profile/session configuration as different things when backing up or moving work.
files.zh: 先选工作目录和会话。识别到创作项目文件后才会显示对应的工作台视图；空目录看到的可能还是 DSH 原生聊天。备份或搬家时，稿件文件要和 DSH 的 profile、会话配置分开处理。

version.en: At DSH commit `493cd77`, the bundled Oh Story manifest pins release `0.7.10` to commit `abe9663` (full commit in the linked manifest). Its skill provider reads the bundled knowledge directory, not your standalone Oh Story installation. A different commit alone does not establish better or worse behavior.
version.zh: 在 DSH commit `493cd77` 里，内置的 Oh Story 固定在 release `0.7.10`（commit `abe9663`，完整 commit 见下方 manifest）。插件读的是包里自带的知识目录，不是你另装的 Oh Story。版本不同，本身不说明功能更好或更差。

review.en: Inspect the actual project files and DSH tool results, not only whether a workbench tab is visible. The plugin is a community plugin for DSH and is not affiliated with, partnered with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
review.zh: 检查实际的项目文件和 DSH 工具的结果，不能只看工作台标签有没有显示。这是 DSH 的社区插件，与 DeepSeek 没有隶属、合作或背书关系。

fit.en: Choose ZenStory Workbench when you want an account-based browser project with a file tree, editor, AI chat and version features, rather than managing an agent-host installation for this workflow.
fit.zh: 想要登录就能用的网页项目：文件树、编辑器、AI 对话和版本管理都在一处，也不想自己装 Agent 时，选 ZenStory 工作台。

environment.en: Open [app.zenstory.ai](https://app.zenstory.ai). The source protects dashboard and project routes with a login guard. Self-hosting is separate: it requires deploying the web/backend stack and configuring model services, not just installing an Oh Story skill.
environment.zh: 打开 [app.zenstory.ai](https://app.zenstory.ai)，登录后进入项目。自己部署是另一回事：要部署网页和后端、配置模型服务，不是装一个 Oh Story skill 就行。

configuration.en: The hosted app works as soon as you sign up; plan limits are on the [pricing page](https://app.zenstory.ai/pricing). For self-hosting, follow the deployment and model setup documentation.
configuration.zh: 在线版注册即用，额度见[定价页](https://app.zenstory.ai/pricing)；自己部署时按部署与模型配置文档操作。

files.en: The instance manages project files and revision features. The inspected draft-export endpoint merges drafts into TXT and checks an active user, project ownership and allowed plan formats. Do not treat this as a complete export of every file, setting, conversation or version history.
files.zh: 项目文件和修订记录都保存在工作台里。导出草稿会把正文合并成一个 TXT，并检查账号、项目归属和方案支持的格式。它不是把所有文件、设置、对话和版本历史完整导出。

version.en: At workbench commit `9bad4fd`, the backend has its own builtin, project and user skill-loading paths. Logging into this service does not establish installation or synchronization of your standalone Oh Story pack, or equivalence with the DSH bundle.
version.zh: 在工作台 commit `9bad4fd` 里，后端有自己的内置、项目和用户 skill。登录工作台不代表装好或同步了你单独使用的 Oh Story，也不说明它和 DSH 里的版本一样。

review.en: Review proposed edits and the actual exported text. Snapshot, comparison and rollback features help revision, but do not guarantee unlimited retention or writing quality. Source inspection here is not a live authenticated-account test or a privacy/security audit.
review.zh: 检查 AI 建议的修改和实际导出的文本。快照、对比和回滚方便改稿，但不保证无限期保留，也不保证写得好。本页只核对了源码，没有测试线上账号功能，也不是隐私或安全审计。

zh: [后端内置、项目与用户 skill 路径](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/zenstory/blob/9bad4fd5f5f14f2ac77372caf177c598aa238a9d/apps/server/agent/skills/loader.py#L27-L34)

en: Start with your material: an idea needs planning, an existing manuscript needs import/context, and a draft needs revision. The [writer’s skill guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers) maps these tasks to an entry point and explains when a simple prompt is enough.
Try a small, non-sensitive passage you own or are authorized to use. Set the intended edit, inspect the changed text and confirm what is saved or exported; keep a backup.

If you specifically want DeepSeek, first distinguish ordinary chat from DeepSeek Harness. The [DeepSeek novel-writing guide](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing) explains the host/plugin setup and a workspace-based starting request. ZenStory Workbench is a separate product.
zh: 先看手头有什么：只有点子，先做规划；已经有小说，先导入；已经有正文，直接修订。[作者 Skill 指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/agent-skills-for-writers)把这些任务对应到入口，也说明什么时候一条提示词就够用。
先拿一小段你自己的、或获准使用的非敏感文本试一下：说清要改什么，看改了哪些地方，确认保存或导出的内容，并留好备份。
如果你就是想用 DeepSeek，先分清普通聊天和 DeepSeek Harness。[DeepSeek 小说写作指南](https://zenstory.ai/dsh/deepseek-novel-writing)讲了怎么准备 DSH 和插件，并给出在工作区里开书的写法。ZenStory 工作台是另一个独立产品。

en: Project files do not move between the three automatically; export a copy and try it before you switch environments.
Local files or a local browser interface do not mean the model runs locally. Before using sensitive material, check the configured model services and the privacy policy that applies.
zh: 三者的项目文件不能自动互通，换环境前先导出一份试试。
用本地文件或本地界面，不代表模型在本地运行。处理敏感材料前，先看清配置的模型服务和适用的隐私政策。
